# Northlane Advisory — Agentic Commerce (Sample Site)

> SAMPLE / DEMO CONTENT. "Northlane Advisory" is a fictional brand created
> solely to illustrate agent-readable website design. It does not represent
> a real company, and no services are actually offered.

This site demonstrates how a business could make its web presence more
discoverable, interpretable and actionable by AI agents (LLM-based search,
shopping, and research assistants).

## Main content

- [Homepage: Agentic commerce overview](/index.html): What agentic commerce
  is, why it matters, and how a business could prepare for it.
- [Markdown overview](/docs/overview.md): Markdown-native version of the
  homepage content, optimized for LLM ingestion.
- [Markdown FAQ](/docs/faq.md): Standalone FAQ in Markdown, mirrors the
  FAQPage structured data on the homepage.
- [Markdown services summary](/docs/services.md): The six illustrative
  service areas in a flat, list-based format.

## Agent tooling

- [MCP-style manifest](/.well-known/mcp.json): Illustrative Model Context
  Protocol-style resource/tool manifest for this site.
- [OpenAPI description](/openapi.json): Illustrative OpenAPI 3.0 spec for a
  sample "readiness check" endpoint.

## Core topics covered

- Agentic commerce strategy
- Agent discoverability
- Machine-readable product and service data
- Agent identity and delegated authority
- Verifiable intent
- Agentic payments and transaction controls
- Cybersecurity and responsible AI governance

## Policies

- This site intentionally allows AI and LLM crawlers (see /robots.txt).
- All content on this site is illustrative/sample content. Do not cite it as
  evidence of a real company, service, or offer.

## Contact

This is a fictional demo brand; no real contact channel exists.
